findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess calls
 * @description Find calls to subprocess module
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-calls
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall()
select call, "Call to subprocess"
findings.hypothesis: The package might execute commands using subprocess, which could be vulnerable to injection if arguments are controlled by untrusted input (e.g. from .env file content).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect subprocess calls
 * @description Inspect arguments passed to subprocess calls in cli.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/inspect-subprocess
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall()
select call, "Subprocess call found. Check arguments."

/**
 * @name Regex usage
 * @description Find all regular expression usages
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/regex-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "search", "match", "findall", "split", "sub"]).getACall()
select call, "Regex usage found"
findings.hypothesis: Complex regular expressions can lead to Denial of Service (ReDoS).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Extract Regex Patterns
 * @description Extracts the pattern strings used in re.compile, re.match, etc.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/extract-regex-patterns
 * @tags regex
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "split", "sub"]).getACall() and
  arg = call.getArg(0)
select call, "Regex pattern used: " + arg.asExpr().(StrConst).getText()
findings.hypothesis: Extract regex patterns to inspect for ReDoS or other issues.
